reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, attractive mission with practical assists and clear progress; dense portrait HUD and uncertain shot feedback limit confidence. Both runs assisted, with limited manual-control samples.
reasons.controls: Native two-contact MOVE/look and ROUTE/FIRE worked. Tap centering and TURN useful. DASH interruption and repositioning behind a pillar added friction; fine aim and sustained manual combat not assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil disable and upload formed a legible sequence; defense competed with objectives and reload prompted repositioning. Assisted travel was prominent; no enjoyment inference for unassessed content.
reasons.presentation: Consistent cyan/amber art direction, rain, weapon silhouette, title and results composition were strong. No audio judgment.
reasons.usability: Readable handbook, planning map, context-changing hold action and visible fresh reset helped. Multiple competing cues and ambiguous CUMULATIVE PLAY TIME label reduced clarity.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and objective status readable; distant enemies, small numbering, small secondary text and dark occluding geometry were harder at 390x844.
